stem_en:
Read the following statements and choose the set of correct statements: In the members of Phaeophyceae,
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

statements.label: A
statements.text: Asexual reproduction occurs usually by biflagellate zoospores.

statements.label: B
statements.text: Sexual reproduction is by oogamous method only.

statements.label: C
statements.text: Stored food is in the form of carbohydrates which is either mannitol or laminarin.

statements.label: D
statements.text: The major pigments found are chlorophyll a, c and carotenoids and xanthophyll.

statements.label: E
statements.text: Vegetative cells have a cellulosic wall, usually covered on the outside by gelatinous coating of algin.

options_en.1: A, B, C and D only
options_en.2: B, C, D and E only
options_en.3: A, C, D and E only
options_en.4: A, B, C and E only

b6_reason: In Phaeophyceae sexual reproduction may be isogamous, anisogamous or oogamous, so B ('oogamous only') is wrong; A, C, D and E are all correct.
b6_working: A true (biflagellate pear-shaped zoospores); B false; C true (mannitol or laminarin); D true (chl a, c, carotenoids, xanthophylls); E true (cellulosic wall with algin coating) -> A, C, D, E only.
